sources.summary:
A Blog post by ggml-org on Hugging Face
A Blog post by ggml-org on Hugging Face
llama.cpp makes it possible to run multi-modal LLMs across a wide range of hardware - from consumer-grade local machines to high-end enterprise servers. Through quantization, optimized backends, and a portable C/C++ implementation, we make AI inference accessible at every level of the software stack. We believe this is the most lightweight, versatile and sensible platform for building cross-platform and private AI pr
sources.recommend_reason_zh: llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0，用主版本号明确 API/ABI 兼容边界；项目历经 3.5 年，已支持 150 多种模型架构变体和主流投机解码，并借助 NVIDIA、AMD 等硬件与 HF Jobs 扩展 CI。

en.reason: llama.cpp v1.0.0 marks the project’s first major release after 3.5 years, setting an API/ABI compatibility boundary while supporting over 150 model architecture variants, mainstream speculative decoding, and CI expanded via NVIDIA, AMD hardware and HF Jobs.

en.reason: chrome-devtools-mcp is an MCP server that lets coding agents like Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot control and debug Chrome directly, with usage statistics enabled by default and performance tools sending data to Google's CrUX API for real-user experience.
